items.title: 구찌 모기업 케링 주가 16% 폭락으로 열린 명품 업계의 겨울
items.summary: Kering shares fell 16% on Oct 23, the worst single-day decline on record, after Gucci's Q3 sales fell 6% despite modest wholesale gains. Kering plans to close 125 stores by year-end; Hermes and LVMH also declined amid a China demand slump, with Korean department stores showing a contrasting tourist-driven boom.

items.title: 케링 주가 16% 폭락…명품 업계 동반 부진
items.summary: Kering stock closed down 16.57% on Oct 23 at 178.12 euros, the largest single-day drop in company history, driven by reduced store traffic in China. CEO Luca De Meo signaled pricing adjustments to reach "middle class" consumers; LVMH hit 10-year lows and Hermes RTW sales fell too.

items.title: 「グッチ」失速でケリングが16.5%急落、エルメスは2日で8.70%下落
items.summary: Kering fell 16.5% intraday on Oct 22-23 as Gucci's comparable Q3 sales dropped 6% and China weakness persisted. Deutsche Bank analysts said Gucci has not shown convincing signs of stabilization; Ferragamo, Richemont and Swatch Group also sold off sharply the same day.

items.title: Gucci卖不动了 开云今年将关掉至少125家门店
items.summary: Kering raised its 2026 net store closure target to at least 125 (up from 100) after already closing 105 in the first nine months. Gucci Q3 revenue fell 4% reported / 6% comparable, with direct retail comps down 9% -- the main drag on group results; CEO outlined a 12-24 month China recovery plan explicitly avoiding broad discounting.

items.source: Weibo aggregator post (via smzdm/什么值得买)
items.title: 「Gucci官价最多砍40%」撞上「买早了差5500没价保」
items.summary: Chinese shopper-community post dissects Gucci's official China price cuts ahead of Double 11 -- Mercato tote cut from 25,500 to 20,000 yuan, Ophidia mini bucket bag cut over 40%. Cites an earlier buyer complaint who was denied compensation for a price drop a month after purchase; frames it as a trust/price-protection issue.

items.title: ???케링, 주가 폭락했다 해서 찾아봄
items.summary: Korean forum poster looks up Kering after seeing stock-crash headlines, noting surprise at learning it owns Gucci, Bottega Veneta, Saint Laurent and Balenciaga -- illustrative of low brand-parent awareness even as the crash made general news. Low engagement (116 views, 1 like, 0 comments).

items.title: 구찌지갑 짭인지 분간좀..
items.summary: Recurring thread pattern on Korea's largest luxury-goods community board where users post Gucci wallet/accessory photos asking others to help distinguish authentic from counterfeit, reflecting ongoing counterfeit-market chatter around the brand (neutral-to-mild-negative per rubric).

items.title: ピーター・フンクがニューヨークの多様性を写す。グッチ2027年クルーズコレクション
items.summary: Gucci unveiled its 'GucciCore' 2027 Cruise campaign shot by street photographer Peter Funch, capturing New Yorkers in motion to showcase wardrobe staples (peacoats, trench coats, suits). Descriptive activation write-up with no independent editorial verdict.

items.title: 구찌 2027 크루즈 컬렉션 "뉴욕의 밤을 물들인 새로운 미학"
items.summary: Korean trade-press recap of Demna's GucciCore 2027 Cruise collection, now arriving at the Cheongdam flagship and other domestic stores ahead of a full rollout through November. Descriptive activation coverage of wardrobe essentials (coats, suits, skirts) with no independent critical verdict.

items.title: 스트레이키즈 리노, 구찌룩으로 남긴 강렬 눈빛…월드투어 속 근황
items.summary: Fan/entertainment-media coverage of Stray Kids member Lino (Gucci global ambassador) posting Gucci-styled photos during his world tour; fandom-driven ambassador coverage, magnitude damped per sentiment rubric fandom trap.

items.source: 每日经济新闻/澎湃新闻 (The Paper)
items.title: 古驰再闭店，高端消费品越来越难了？
items.summary: Chinese business-media analysis tied to Kering's Q3 report notes Gucci has now net-closed stores repeatedly amid prolonged China weakness, framing it within a broader slowdown across high-end consumer categories rather than a Gucci-specific failure, but still citing Gucci as the epicenter.

items.title: Gucci卖不动了 开云今年将关掉至少125家门店
items.summary: Trade coverage of Kering's Q3 results confirming the raised store-closure target (125+) and detailing that Gucci's direct-retail comparable sales fell 9%, the single biggest drag on group revenue; management reiterated no broad discounting strategy for China.
